questions.stem: A 55-year-old man with a history of type 2 diabetes and hypertension is brought to the emergency department after collapsing at home. On examination, he is found to be unresponsive with agonal breathing. His pulse is weak and thready, and his pupils are dilated and non-reactive to light. The emergency team initiates advanced cardiovascular life support protocols. Question : In the context of acute management, which of the following is NOT considered a primary component of the "Bishop’s triad of life" that must be rapidly assessed and managed?
